exposure: breastfeeding duration (never breastfed, up to 2 months, 3 to 7 months, 8 months or longer)
cohort: The study sample comprised 10,550 mother-child pairs from the Early Childhood Longitudinal Study, Birth Cohort (ECLS-B).
finding: Breastfeeding duration helped prevent or overcome elevated body mass (EBM), with effects varying by the child's sex.
